customers_say: Customers find the water purifier to be of good quality, with positive feedback about its taste, installation process, and ease of use. The water quality receives positive reviews, with one customer noting a substantial improvement in filtration quality. However, durability is a concern as multiple customers report filters breaking within 6 months of use. Moreover, reliability is mixed, with some customers reporting the purifier stops working, and opinions on value for money are divided between those who find it good for the price and those who consider it not worth the investment.

reviews.author: Amin Shaikh
reviews.title: Excellent Product Quality and Performance
reviews.body: Very satisfied with my KENT RO Supreme Plus water purifier. Excellent product quality, stylish design, and useful features. Happy with my purchase and would recommend it to others!
